name: NOAA
description: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, the United States federal agency for weather, climate, oceans, and coasts, publishing forecasts, research, and environmental datasets.
best_for: official US weather and climate data

name: NOAA Climate.gov
description: NOAA climate science and information portal covering climate variability, drought, sea level rise, and the US Climate Resilience Toolkit, with explainers, maps, and teaching resources.

name: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP)
description: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies analysis of global surface temperature combining station and ocean records, offering gridded anomalies, zonal means, and plain text and netCDF downloads.
publisher: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies

name: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S)
description: European Commission service on climate change, providing the Climate Data Store, the ERA5 reanalysis, seasonal forecasts, and European and global climate indicators.

name: ECMWF
description: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts, an intergovernmental organisation producing global numerical weather forecasts, the ERA5 reanalysis, and open forecast datasets.
publisher: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts

name: World Meteorological Organization
description: United Nations specialized agency for meteorology, climatology, hydrology, and related geophysical sciences, coordinating standards and observation programmes across national weather services.
best_for: state of the global climate reports

name: Met Office Hadley Centre Observations (HadOBS)
description: Met Office Hadley Centre page hosting observed climate datasets such as the HadCRUT global temperature series, HadISST sea surface temperature, and related gridded products.

name: Berkeley Earth
description: Independent nonprofit producing an open land surface temperature record from a large weather station archive, plus air quality analyses, with data files and plots available for download.

name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
description: NOAA archive for weather, climate, and geophysical data, hosting station records, paleoclimatology collections, and ocean and satellite datasets, with a public access data service API.

name: India Meteorological Department
description: National meteorological service of India providing weather forecasts, cyclone warnings, monsoon monitoring, and observations for the Indian subcontinent.
publisher: India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences

name: Bureau of Meteorology
description: Australian national agency for weather, climate, and water, publishing forecasts, warnings, observations, river and hydrology data, and historical climate records.
publisher: Commonwealth of Australia, Bureau of Meteorology

name: Japan Meteorological Agency
description: National meteorological service of Japan, publishing forecasts, earthquake and tsunami information, climate statistics, and observation data for Japan and the northwest Pacific.

name: Deutscher Wetterdienst
description: German Meteorological Service, providing forecasts and warnings, national climate monitoring, and an open data server with station observations and model output.

name: Meteo-France
description: French national meteorological service, publishing forecasts, vigilance warnings, and climate data for mainland France and its overseas territories.

name: National Weather Service
description: United States National Weather Service under NOAA, providing official forecasts, watches, and warnings, with a documented public web API for point forecasts and observations.

name: United States Environmental Protection Agency
description: United States federal agency for environmental protection, publishing regulations, air and water quality data, chemical safety information, and enforcement records.

name: European Environment Agency
description: European Union agency providing independent information on the environment and climate, including country indicators, air quality data, and the State of the Environment reports.

name: GBIF
description: Global Biodiversity Information Facility, an open registry mediating species occurrence records from museums, herbaria, and citizen science projects, searchable and downloadable through its portal and API.

name: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
description: Global inventory of the conservation status of plant, animal, and fungus species, maintained by IUCN with expert assessments assigning threat categories such as vulnerable or endangered.
publisher: International Union for Conservation of Nature
access_requirements: API access requires registration for a token; some data are restricted.

name: United Nations Environment Programme
description: United Nations body setting the global environmental agenda, publishing assessments on climate, biodiversity, chemicals, and pollution, including the Emissions Gap and Adaptation Gap reports.

name: Global Forest Watch
description: World Resources Institute platform for monitoring forests, with near real time tree cover loss alerts, fire data, and country dashboards drawing on satellite datasets.

name: Convention on Biological Diversity
description: United Nations treaty website providing the text of the Convention and the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, national biodiversity strategies, and meeting and decision documents.

name: Ramsar Convention on Wetlands
description: Intergovernmental treaty website listing Wetlands of International Importance, with site information sheets, treaty text, and guidance on the wise use of wetlands.

name: CITES
description: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species website with the treaty text, appendices of regulated species, national implementing documents, and meeting decisions.

name: eBird
description: Cornell Lab of Ornithology checklist database where birders submit observations, providing range maps, bar charts, and one of the largest biodiversity datasets, available to researchers on request.

name: Living Planet Index
description: Database tracking trends in vertebrate populations worldwide, maintained by the Zoological Society of London with WWF, providing the indicator behind the Living Planet Report.

name: AirNow
description: United States government portal for current air quality, publishing the Air Quality Index, forecasts, and fire and smoke maps, with a companion API for data feeds.

name: OpenAQ
description: Nonprofit aggregator of government and research grade air quality measurements from monitoring stations worldwide, harmonized and served through an open data platform and API.

name: Ocean Biodiversity Information System
description: International open access platform under IOC UNESCO mediating marine species occurrence records from surveys and monitoring programmes, searchable and downloadable through its API.

name: Biodiversity Heritage Library
description: Open digital library digitizing published biodiversity literature and archival collections from natural history libraries, with taxonomic name indexing and an open API.

name: International Energy Agency
description: Intergovernmental organisation publishing energy statistics, country profiles, market reports, and analysis on clean energy transitions for member and partner countries.

name: US Energy Information Administration
description: United States statistical agency for energy, offering production, consumption, price, and international energy data with an open data API and bulk file downloads.

name: International Renewable Energy Agency
description: Intergovernmental agency supporting renewable energy adoption, publishing capacity statistics, technology cost data, and country reports on solar, wind, hydro, and bioenergy.

name: International Atomic Energy Agency
description: United Nations agency for nuclear cooperation and safeguards, publishing nuclear safety standards, country profiles, and statistics on nuclear power and peaceful applications.

name: IAEA Power Reactor Information System
description: IAEA database on nuclear power reactors worldwide, covering operating status, capacity, performance, and lifetime electricity generation for each unit, with country level downloads.

name: US Department of Energy
description: United States cabinet department for energy policy, national laboratories, and science programmes, publishing reports, funding announcements, and technical analyses.

name: Global Energy Monitor
description: Nonprofit researching the fossil fuel economy, maintaining open wikis and datasets on coal plants, oil and gas infrastructure, mines, and proposed energy projects worldwide.

name: National Renewable Energy Laboratory
description: United States Department of Energy laboratory for renewable energy and efficiency research, publishing publications, resource maps and data, and developer APIs for solar and wind.

name: Joint Organisations Data Initiative
description: Inter secretariat program harmonizing monthly oil and gas supply and demand questionnaires submitted by participating countries, providing two open databases and query tools.

name: REN21
description: Global renewable energy policy network of governments, academia, and industry, best known for the annual Renewables Global Status Report and related policy data collections.

name: World Energy Council
description: Global energy forum with member committees in many countries, publishing scenario studies, energy trilemma country assessments, and reports on energy transition issues.

name: USGS Energy Resources Program
description: United States Geological Survey program assessing national and world oil, gas, coal, and geothermal resources, publishing assessments, maps, and datasets.

name: FAOSTAT
description: Food and Agriculture Organization statistical database covering production, trade, land use, emissions, prices, and food supply for over two hundred countries and territories since 1961.
publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

name: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service
description: United States agricultural statistics agency conducting the Census of Agriculture and hundreds of surveys, with the Quick Stats query tool and a public data API.

name: USDA Economic Research Service
description: United States Department of Agriculture research agency publishing economic data and reports on farming, food prices, rural development, food security, and nutrition assistance.

name: CGIAR
description: Global agricultural research partnership of research centres working on crops, livestock, fisheries, forests, and food systems in low and middle income countries.

name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
description: United Nations agency leading international efforts against hunger, publishing assessments such as the State of Food and Agriculture, statistical yearbooks, and country programme documents.
publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

name: AQUASTAT
description: FAO global information system on water resources and agricultural water management, with country profiles, irrigation data, and datasets on water withdrawal by sector.
publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

name: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service
description: United States agency promoting agricultural exports, publishing production, supply, and distribution estimates for crops worldwide and global agricultural trade data.

name: AGROVOC
description: FAO controlled vocabulary covering agriculture, forestry, fisheries, food, and related domains, published as a multilingual SKOS concept scheme with links to other vocabularies.
publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

name: Land Matrix
description: Independent monitoring initiative documenting large scale land acquisitions and their impacts, with an open database of deals reported by sources and reviewed by regional partners.

name: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification
description: Multi partner standard for classifying acute food insecurity, publishing country analyses and population estimates by severity phase for crisis affected regions.

name: World Food Programme
description: United Nations agency delivering food assistance in emergencies, publishing needs assessments, market monitoring, and the HungerMap for food security tracking.

name: International Food Policy Research Institute
description: Research institute of the CGIAR system providing policy research and open datasets on food security, nutrition, agricultural productivity, and rural livelihoods in developing regions.

name: UN World Population Prospects
description: United Nations Population Division estimates and projections of population size, fertility, mortality, and migration for every country, downloadable in CSV and viewable through an online portal.

name: Our World in Data
description: Online publication of the Global Change Data Lab presenting long run datasets and charts on population, health, energy, environment, and living standards, with downloadable country indicators.

name: IPUMS
description: University of Minnesota project harmonizing census and survey microdata from around the world across population, health, employment, and time use collections, free after registration.
access_requirements: Free account registration required to build and download extracts.

name: Census International Database
description: United States Census Bureau tool providing demographic indicators and projections for over two hundred countries, including population by age and sex with detailed tables.

name: Population Reference Bureau
description: Nonprofit informing policy with population data, publishing the World Population Data Sheet, country indicators, and explainers on fertility, aging, and migration.

name: Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research
description: German research institute studying the causes and consequences of demographic change, publishing working papers, the open access journal Demographic Research, and data resources.

name: Human Mortality Database
description: Joint project of the University of California, Berkeley and the Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research offering detailed mortality and population data by age and sex for countries with complete vital registration.
publisher: University of California, Berkeley and Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research
access_requirements: Free account required to download data files.

name: CDC WONDER
description: United States Centers for Disease Control online query system for public health data, including detailed mortality, natality, and disease incidence records drawn from national registers.
publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

name: United Nations Population Fund
description: United Nations agency for sexual and reproductive health and rights, publishing the State of World Population report and the World Population Dashboard of demographic indicators.

name: Human Fertility Database
description: Joint project of the Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research and the Vienna Institute of Demography providing detailed fertility data by age of mother for countries with good birth registration.
best_for: birth series by cohort and period
publisher: Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research and Vienna Institute of Demography
access_requirements: Free account required to download data.

name: French Institute for Demographic Studies
description: French public research institute on population, publishing studies on fertility, mortality, migration, and family change, plus country population handbooks and data tools.

name: Migration Data Portal
description: International Organization for Migration portal offering comparable migration statistics, definitions, and thematic guides, with downloadable country and regional data.

name: Gallup
description: Analytics firm known for the Gallup World Poll and US public opinion tracking, publishing articles and toplines on wellbeing, work, politics, and global attitudes.

name: Pew Research Center
description: Nonpartisan research organization conducting surveys on US politics, demography, religion, science, and global attitudes, with methods files and many datasets available for download.

name: Eurobarometer
description: European Commission survey program measuring public opinion in EU member states and candidate countries, publishing standard and special Eurobarometer reports and datasets.

name: World Values Survey
description: Global research project repeated in waves since 1981 measuring values, beliefs, and attitudes across societies, with questionnaires and data files available through its site.
access_requirements: Free account required to download data files.

name: Afrobarometer
description: Pan African research network conducting nationally representative attitude surveys on democracy, governance, and the economy across African countries, with online analysis and data downloads.
access_requirements: Registration required for bulk data downloads.

name: Latinobarometro
description: Annual public opinion survey covering Latin American countries on democracy, the economy, and social issues, run by the Latinobarometro Corporation in Santiago, Chile.
access_requirements: Free account required to download data files.

name: Asian Barometer Survey
description: Regional survey program measuring public attitudes toward democracy, governance, and development across East, Southeast, South, and Central Asian countries, with data for participating countries.

name: American National Election Studies
description: Long running academic survey of United States voters funded by the National Science Foundation, providing time series and panel datasets on voting behavior and political attitudes.
publisher: Stanford University and the University of Michigan
access_requirements: Free account required to download data files.

name: General Social Survey
description: NORC at the University of Chicago survey of United States adults tracking social attitudes and demographics since 1972, with data files and an online analysis tool.
publisher: NORC at the University of Chicago

name: European Social Survey
description: Academic cross national survey repeated every two years across European countries, measuring attitudes, beliefs, and behavior with strictly comparable methods and free data.

name: International Social Survey Programme
description: Collaboration of national social science surveys running an annual topical module on subjects such as religion, work, and the environment, with archived datasets for each round.

name: Arab Barometer
description: Regional research project surveying public attitudes on politics, governance, religion, and international relations across Middle East and North African countries, with downloadable data.

name: National Center for Education Statistics
description: United States federal statistical agency for education, running NAEP, IPEDS, and school surveys, and publishing the Condition of Education and the Digest of Education Statistics.

name: OECD PISA
description: Programme for International Student Assessment testing fifteen year olds in reading, mathematics, and science on a three year cycle, publishing results, country notes, and assessment data.
publisher: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

name: NAEP Nations Report Card
description: Official United States report on national and state student achievement from the National Assessment of Educational Progress, with results by subject, grade, and demographic group.

name: Education Resources Information Center
description: Sponsored by the United States Institute of Education Sciences, ERIC indexes journal articles, reports, and grey literature on education research and practice, with a public API.

name: TIMSS and PIRLS International Study Center
description: Boston College center administering the Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study and the Progress in International Reading Literacy Study, publishing frameworks and results.
publisher: Lynch School of Education, Boston College

name: ICPSR
description: Interuniversity Consortium for Political and Social Research at the University of Michigan, a major data archive of social science studies spanning political science, sociology, health, and education.
access_requirements: Account required; most downloads need institutional membership or an approved request.

name: UK Data Service
description: United Kingdom national data archive for the social sciences and humanities, providing census microdata, longitudinal studies, qualitative collections, and survey data with registration.
access_requirements: Free registration required to download data.

name: GESIS
description: Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences, operating German and European survey data archives including the Eurobarometer archive, with data access, methods training, and analysis tools.
publisher: GESIS Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences
access_requirements: Free registration required for data downloads.

name: CESSDA
description: Consortium of European Social Science Data Archives, a European Research Infrastructure Consortium linking national data archives and providing the Data Catalogue and data management training.

name: IIE Open Doors
description: Institute of International Education report and data portal on international educational exchange, covering international students in the United States and US students studying abroad.

name: US Department of Education
description: United States federal department administering education policy and funding, publishing grant programs, civil rights data, guidance, and national education statistics through its agencies.

name: World Bank EdStats
description: World Bank education data portal bringing together indicators on access, completion, learning, and finance, with country dashboards and query tools linked to World Bank databases.
